Title: Cashier signs in with valid PIN
Preconditions: App at login screen; cashier user exists
Steps: 1. Tap cashier user. 2. Enter correct PIN. 3. Submit.
Expected Result: App loads main POS screen with cashier name in header.

Title: Sign-in with wrong PIN is rejected
Steps: 1. Tap any user. 2. Enter wrong PIN. 3. Submit.
Expected Result: Error message shown ("Invalid PIN" or similar). User stays on login screen. After 3 failed attempts, throttle / cooldown shown.

Title: Sign-out from header (manager-only)
Preconditions: Logged in as cashier; cashier should NOT see sign-out
Steps: 1. Look at header for sign-out button. 2. Sign out as cashier (if button exists, click it). 3. Sign in as manager. 4. Look for sign-out. 5. Click.
Expected Result: Cashier does NOT see sign-out (or sees it but with permission denied). Manager sees sign-out and can use it.

Title: Open new shift with opening cash float
Preconditions: Logged in as cashier; no shift open on this terminal
Steps: 1. Open shift dialog. 2. Enter opening cash (e.g., 100.00 EUR). 3. Confirm.
Expected Result: Shift opens. Header shows shift status "Open". Opening cash recorded.

Title: Re-opening with shift already open shows current state
Steps: 1. Try to open another shift on the same terminal.
Expected Result: Existing open shift is shown; new-shift option disabled or asks to close first.

Title: Exact cash tender
Steps: 1. Add product to cart. 2. Tap Pay. 3. Choose Cash. 4. Enter 10.00. 5. Confirm.
Expected Result: Receipt printed/previewed. Change due = 0.00. Receipt total = 10.00.

Title: Overpay with change due
Steps: 1. Add product. 2. Pay Cash. 3. Enter 20.00. 4. Confirm.
Expected Result: Change due = 10.00. Receipt shows tendered 20.00, change due 10.00.

Title: Receipt scale (EUR)
Steps: 1. Complete any cash sale. 2. Look at receipt monetary display.
Expected Result: All amounts shown with 2 decimals (e.g., €10.00, NOT €10.000).

Title: Receipt scale (TND)
Preconditions: Tenant currency = TND (if available; SKIP if no TND tenant)
Steps: 1. Complete any cash sale on a TND tenant. 2. Look at receipt monetary display.
Expected Result: All amounts shown with 3 decimals (e.g., 10.000 TND).

Title: Underpay outside tolerance is REJECTED
Preconditions: Open shift; product priced 10.00 EUR; tolerance settings active
Steps: 1. Add product 10.00. 2. Pay Cash. 3. Enter 8.00 (more than €0.50 short for FR or 0.5% of 10.00). 4. Try to confirm.
Expected Result: Sale is rejected with clear error message. Receipt is NOT printed. Cart preserved.

Title: Underpay within tolerance is ACCEPTED with "Rounding" line
Steps: 1. Add product 10.02. 2. Pay Cash. 3. Enter 10.00 (€0.02 short — within FR tolerance). 4. Confirm.
Expected Result: Sale is accepted. Receipt shows a "Rounding" line of -€0.02. Total paid line still 10.02. Change due = 0.

Title: Multi-tender (cash + card)
Steps: 1. Add product 50.00. 2. Pay. 3. Tender 30.00 cash. 4. Tender 20.00 card. 5. Confirm.
Expected Result: Sale completed. Receipt shows two tenders. Total paid = 50.00.

Title: Cancel mid-checkout
Steps: 1. Add items. 2. Tap Pay. 3. Cancel before completing.
Expected Result: Returns to cart screen with items intact. No receipt printed.

Title: Apply line-level discount via fullscreen modal
Steps: 1. Tap a line item. 2. Tap "Discount" / line discount action. 3. Modal opens fullscreen. 4. Enter percentage (e.g., 10%). 5. Confirm.
Expected Result: Modal opens fullscreen (not popover). Discount applied to that line only. Line total shows discount. Cart total recalculates.

Title: Edit + remove line discount
Steps: 1. Tap the line. 2. Open discount modal. 3. Change to 5% (or remove). 4. Confirm.
Expected Result: Discount updates or removes. Cart total recalculates correctly.

Title: Apply transaction-level discount via fullscreen modal
Steps: 1. Tap "Discount" at the cart level (NOT a specific line). 2. Modal opens fullscreen. 3. Enter amount or percent. 4. Confirm.
Expected Result: Modal fullscreen. Discount applied to entire transaction. Receipt shows the transaction discount line.

Title: Sub-tolerance discount on POS (UI hint)
Steps: 1. Cart with line at 10.00. 2. Try to apply a discount of 0.05 (below FR €0.50 tolerance threshold).
Expected Result: Either (a) the discount is allowed but flagged with a warning ("below tolerance") or (b) the input shows an inline below-tolerance hint. NOT silently accepted without feedback.
Notes: Phase 4 anti-abuse FE mirror; behavior depends on policy

Title: Tax math after discount is correct
Steps: 1. Add product 100.00 (with 20% VAT). 2. Apply 10% discount. 3. Look at receipt totals.
Expected Result: Subtotal: 90.00. VAT: 18.00. Total: 108.00. (Or whatever the tax rules are — verify the math is internally consistent.)

Title: Hold a cart, recall it later
Steps: 1. Add items. 2. Tap Hold. 3. Cart clears. 4. Tap Recall (or held orders list). 5. Pick the held cart.
Expected Result: Held cart appears in the list. Recalling restores all items, prices, discounts.

Title: Complete sale from recalled cart
Steps: 1. Recall held cart. 2. Tap Pay. 3. Complete cash sale.
Expected Result: Sale completes. Receipt printed. Held cart removed from list.

Title: Disconnect mid-shift, complete sale offline
Preconditions: Open shift; turn off WiFi or unplug ethernet
Steps: 1. Disconnect network. 2. Add product. 3. Pay cash. 4. Confirm.
Expected Result: Sale still completes. Receipt prints with a fiscal hash. App may show "offline" indicator.

Title: Reconnect, sync queue drains
Steps: 1. Reconnect network. 2. Wait ~30 seconds. 3. Look at sync indicator / pending count.
Expected Result: Sync indicator shows queue draining. Pending count reaches zero. No errors in console.
Notes: Verifies fiscal chain integrity across offline → online

Title: Open End-of-Day modal
Preconditions: Open shift with at least one cash sale
Steps: 1. Tap End of Day / Close Shift.
Expected Result: EOD modal opens. Shows per-tender expected amounts (Cash, Card, etc.). Lists each tender row with expected and an empty actual field.

Title: Per-tender breakdown shows ALL enabled tenders
Steps: 1. Look at tender list.
Expected Result: All enabled tenders appear, even those with zero transactions in this shift.

Title: Enter actual cash count (matching expected)
Steps: 1. Enter actual cash equal to expected. 2. Tap Confirm.
Expected Result: Variance = 0. Severity = "Balanced" or "Info". No manager PIN required. Z-report can be generated.

Title: Variance within soft threshold
Steps: 1. Enter actual cash = expected + 3.00 (€3 over). 2. Confirm.
Expected Result: Variance shown. Severity = "Warning" or similar non-critical. May require a reason note but NOT manager PIN. Z-report can be generated.

Title: Variance within hard threshold (manager PIN)
Steps: 1. Enter actual cash = expected + 15.00. 2. Confirm.
Expected Result: Manager PIN modal appears. Cashier cannot proceed without manager. Manager enters PIN, sale proceeds.

Title: Variance over hard threshold
Steps: 1. Enter actual cash = expected + 50.00. 2. Confirm.
Expected Result: Either (a) blocked outright with a critical error, OR (b) requires manager PIN AND fires a fraud alert.

Title: Blind mode on (Otospex-style)
Steps: 1. Open EOD. 2. Verify expected amounts are HIDDEN. 3. Enter actual. 4. Confirm.
Expected Result: Expected column shows "—" or hidden. Cashier counts blind. Reveal happens after confirm.
Notes: Otospex tenants typically blind=ON; IziPOS typically OFF

Title: Reason note required for variance
Steps: 1. Enter actual cash with €3 over. 2. Try to confirm without reason note.
Expected Result: Form rejects with "Reason required" message. Adding reason allows confirm.

Title: Generate Z-report after EOD
Steps: 1. After EOD confirm, generate Z-report (or it auto-prints). 2. Look at the printed Z.
Expected Result: Z prints. Contains: shift open/close times, opening cash, expected/actual per tender, variance, cash count details, manager override info if used, fiscal hash.

Title: Z-report includes tolerance_summary
Preconditions: At least one B06-style tolerance writeoff in this shift
Steps: 1. After E01-style EOD, generate Z. 2. Look for "Tolerance Writeoffs" or similar block.
Expected Result: Z shows total tolerance writeoff amount, count of writeoffs, currency. Even if shift had ZERO writeoffs, the block exists with zeros.

Title: Receipt-printer-formatted Z-report
Steps: 1. Look at the Z output as it was printed. 2. Verify amounts use currency-native scale.
Expected Result: EUR amounts: 2 decimals. TND amounts: 3 decimals. NOT all printed at scale 3.

Title: Z-report cash-count strings are localized
Preconditions: Test in EN, then in FR (if FR locale available)
Steps: 1. Set app language to FR. 2. Generate Z (run a quick shift end-to-end in FR). 3. Look at Z labels.
Expected Result: "CASH COUNT" → "RAPPROCHEMENT CAISSE" (or similar FR translation). NOT hardcoded English on the receipt.

Title: Cashier role limitations
Steps: 1. Try to access fraud / cash-control settings page (admin).
Expected Result: Access denied or menu item hidden. Cashier cannot configure tolerance/fraud thresholds.

Title: Manager role
Steps: 1. Verify EOD escalation modal works. 2. Manager can enter PIN to override.
Expected Result: Manager-PIN flow works as in E05.

Title: Operator role for delivery edit/delete
Preconditions: Logged in as operator (if role is in scope)
Steps: 1. Try to edit a delivery note. 2. Try to delete one.
Expected Result: Operator can edit AND delete delivery notes (per the new permissions in audit HIGH-E remediation).
Notes: If operator role isn't in IziPOS UI; mark N/A
